dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?

dialogue.answer: It's $25. Would you like to try it on?
options: It's $25. Would you like to try it on?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Do you have this dress in size medium?

context: Asking for help in a store

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where can I find the electronics section?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.answer: It's on the second floor, next to the elevator.
options: It's on the second floor, next to the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.text: Your total is $47.50. How would you like to pay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.answer: I'll pay by credit card, please.
options: I'll pay by credit card, please.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.answer: You can return items within 30 days with the receipt.
dialogue.answer_uz: Chek bilan 30 kun ichida qaytarishingiz mumkin.
options: You can return items within 30 days with the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Is there any discount on this item?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.answer: Of course! The fitting rooms are right over there.
options: Of course! The fitting rooms are right over there.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: What's the difference between these two phones?
dialogue.text_uz: Bu ikki telefon o'rtasidagi farq nima?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.answer: This one has a better camera, while the other has longer battery life.
dialogue.answer_uz: Bunisi yaxshiroq kameraga ega, ikkinchisida batareya uzoqroq ishlaydi.
options: This one has a better camera, while the other has longer battery life.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.text: Do you have a loyalty card?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.answer: Yes, here it is. Can I also use this coupon?
dialogue.answer_uz: Ha, mana. Bu kuponni ham ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
options: Yes, here it is. Can I also use this coupon?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Could you gift wrap this for me, please?
dialogue.text_uz: Buni sovg'a qilib o'rab bera olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.answer: Certainly! Would you like a bow on top?
options: Certainly! Would you like a bow on top?
